suggestions: As an Agency user, I want to filter and search the Submission Dashboard by status, date, and submission ID, so that I can quickly locate specific submissions.
As a FABS user, I want to download validation error and warning reports, so that I can review and correct issues offline.
As a FABS user, I want to see a progress indicator during file upload and validation, so that I know the system is processing my large file and not stalled.
As an Agency user, I want to receive email notifications when my submission status changes, so that I can take action without continuously checking the dashboard.
As a Developer, I want to include the submission ID and user context in application logs, so that I can trace issues for a specific submission.
As a FABS user, I want to preview parsed column values from my uploaded file before validation, so that I can verify the system interpreted my file correctly.
As an Agency user, I want to save an in-progress submission as a draft and return later, so that I do not lose work if my session is interrupted.
As an Agency user, I want to see validation messages categorized as errors versus warnings with distinct severity labels, so that I can prioritize fixes.
As a FABS user, I want to access context-sensitive help for each validation error code, so that I can resolve errors without leaving the submission page.
As a Broker user, I want to revalidate a corrected file without creating a new submission, so that I can iterate on corrections efficiently.
As an Agency user, I want to see the SAM registration status and date for each DUNS in my file, so that I can understand DUNS validation failures.
As a data user, I want to query FABS data through an API, so that I can integrate it with external analytical tools.
As an Agency user, I want to compare my uploaded file to the resulting published data, so that I can verify that only intended records were published.
As a FABS user, I want to see a count of validation errors and warnings before publishing, so that I can quickly estimate correction effort.
As a Developer, I want to queue large validation jobs asynchronously, so that the web request does not time out for large submissions.
As an Agency user, I want to know which data elements are required for a FABS submission before uploading, so that I can prepare a compliant file.
As a FABS user, I want to see the status of my D File generation request, so that I know when the file is ready to download.
As a data user, I want FABS data to include standardized award identifiers, so that I can link records across federal spending datasets.
As an Agency user, I want to export my submission data to a spreadsheet-compatible file, so that I can review it in Excel after upload.
As a UI designer, I want to recruit actual agency users for usability testing, so that feedback reflects real submission workflows.
As an Owner, I want to prioritize UI improvements based on user testing results, so that the most impactful changes are addressed first.
As a UI designer, I want to share detailed user testing findings with the development team, so that developers understand the context behind requested changes.
As a tester, I want automated end-to-end tests for FABS derivation and validation rules, so that regressions are caught before release.
As an Agency user, I want to see a clear explanation of the difference between FABS and DABS submission periods and requirements, so that I submit to the correct application.
As an Agency user, I want to add notes or comments to a submission, so that I can communicate context to my team or support staff.
As a FABS user, I want to delete an erroneous submission before it is published, so that I can prevent incorrect data from being published.
As a DevOps engineer, I want environment configuration management to be automated and consistent across Staging and Production, so that deployment differences do not cause issues.
As a FABS user, I want to run a client-side check on file format before upload, so that obviously invalid files do not consume validation time.
As an Agency user, I want the system to enforce submission period close and prevent changes after the deadline, so that late changes cannot disrupt reporting integrity.
As a FABS user, I want to see historical validation results for resubmitted files, so that I can confirm which issues were fixed between versions.
As a data user, I want a public data dictionary for FABS fields, so that I can understand field definitions when accessing published data.
As a Developer, I want FABS and DABS to share domain validation logic where applicable, so that users get consistent results across applications.
As an Agency user, I want to see detailed file-level error examples with affected rows and columns, so that I can locate issues in my source file quickly.
As an Agency user, I want to know if my uploaded file contains duplicate rows before publication, so that I can remove duplicates early.
As a data user, I want historical FABS data to be accessible through the same raw file interface as current submissions, so that I can retrieve older files.
As an Agency user, I want to see which validation rules have changed since my last submission, so that I know what may cause new errors.
As a FABS user, I want to see an estimated completion time for validation jobs, so that I can plan around long-running validations.
As a data user, I want to download FABS data as bulk CSV files, so that I can analyze it without using the raw agency file interface.

details.story: As a Researcher, I want to generate an HTML report from a Data Package with summary statistics and visualizations, so that I can share findings without interactive tools.
details.reason: Visualizations and summary tools exist, but not combined into a portable report.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to create a custom Data Package profile for my domain, so that I can enforce domain-specific fields and constraints.
details.reason: Profiles are used for validation, but no creation workflow is specified.

details.story: As a DeveloperWrangler, I want to validate only a selected resource or subset of rows in a large Data Package, so that I can get fast feedback without validating the entire package.
details.reason: Validation stories cover full data, but large data needs incremental checks.

details.story: As a Researcher, I want to export a Data Package to Parquet format, so that I can use compressed columnar storage for large data analysis.
details.reason: Existing exports target spreadsheets and languages, not columnar big-data formats.

details.story: As a Developer, I want an Apache Airflow integration, so that I can orchestrate Data Package ingestion and validation in scheduled pipelines.
details.reason: Existing integrations cover data stores but not workflow orchestration.

details.story: As a Developer, I want to stream large tabular resources from a Data Package, so that I can process data that does not fit in memory.
details.reason: Existing loading stories assume data can be loaded into memory.

details.story: As a Developer, I want to get a Data Package into Java in seconds, so that I can start using the data in JVM-based analysis and pipelines.
details.reason: The project includes quick-start integrations for several programming languages but not Java, which is common in data engineering.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to follow a publisher, so that I am notified when they publish new data packages.
details.reason: Notifications are only described for changes to a package, not for a publisher.

details.story: As a Consumer, I want to view a list of available versions or tags for a data package, so that I can choose the right one.
details.reason: Consumers can download a specific version but no version listing is described.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to mark a version as deprecated, so that consumers are warned not to use it.
details.reason: Versioning exists but no lifecycle warning for old versions is described.

details.story: As an Owner, I want to assign roles to members of my publisher, so that I control who can publish or manage packages.
details.reason: Membership exists, but role assignment is not specified beyond removing an owner.

details.story: As an Owner, I want to see an audit log of changes made by members, so that I can track who changed what and when.
details.reason: Multiple members can modify packages but change attribution is not described.

details.story: As an Owner, I want to transfer ownership of my publisher to another member, so that the organization can continue without me.
details.reason: Ownership lifecycle is missing from the publisher organization model.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to create or join multiple publisher organizations, so that I can separate different projects.
details.reason: A publisher account may need multiple organizations but only membership in one publisher is implied.

details.story: As an Admin, I want to remove or hide a data package that violates terms, so that the platform remains trustworthy.
details.reason: Admin features cover metrics and billing but not content moderation.

details.story: As an Admin, I want to view and deactivate user accounts, so that I can manage access and prevent abuse.
details.reason: Admins can invite users but no user management or deactivation is described.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to subscribe to a pricing plan and enter payment details, so that I can use paid features.
details.reason: Pricing is mentioned for admins and publishers, but no subscription flow exists.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to see my current usage against plan limits, so that I can avoid service interruption.
details.reason: Billing and pricing exist but no usage visibility for publishers is described.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to generate a secret access link for a private data package, so that I can share it with people without requiring accounts.
details.reason: Private sharing with a team exists, but ad hoc secret sharing is not described.

As an OlderPerson, I want to delete specific personal data collected by ALFRED, so that I can remove information I no longer want stored.
As an OlderPerson, I want to see a simple log of who accessed my personal data and when, so that I can detect unexpected access.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to show or play a clear indicator when its microphone is actively listening, so that I always know when I am being recorded.
As an OlderPerson, I want to train ALFRED to recognize my voice despite changes such as a cold or background noise, so that it keeps reacting only to me.
As an OlderPerson, I want to switch ALFRED's spoken language, so that I can use it in my preferred language.
As an OlderPerson, I want to adjust the speech rate of ALFRED at any time with a simple command, so that I can make it faster or slower as needed.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to confirm critical actions such as sending an emergency alert or making a payment before executing them, so that I do not trigger them by accident.
As an OlderPerson, I want to cancel an unintended command with a stop word or button, so that I can quickly prevent unwanted actions.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide help prompts or a list of available voice commands, so that I can learn what I can say.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to clarify commands it did not understand, so that I can correct it instead of starting over.
As an OlderPerson, I want to configure emergency contacts and their priority order, so that ALFRED contacts the right person first.
As an OlderPerson, I want to test the emergency alert without actually contacting emergency services, so that I can trust the feature without causing a false alarm.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to warn me early when the battery is getting low during daily use, so that I can charge it before it shuts down.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to automatically switch to a power-saving mode when the battery is low, so that it lasts until I can charge it.
As an OlderPerson, I want to charge ALFRED without removing it from daily use, so that I can keep it with me while it charges.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to connect to my hearing aid or cochlear implant, so that I can hear it clearly through my own hearing device.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide visual alerts in addition to audio alerts, so that I do not miss important notifications if I have hearing trouble.
As an OlderPerson, I want high-contrast display themes, so that I can read visual content more easily.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to read on-screen text aloud, so that I can understand content even with visual trouble.
As an OlderPerson, I want a simple way to reset ALFRED to factory settings, so that I can recover from a serious problem without technical help.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to show its connection status and help me reconnect if it is offline, so that I can rely on calls and emergency features.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to update itself automatically without technical knowledge, so that I always have the latest functions and security fixes.
As an OlderPerson, I want to designate a small group of trusted contacts for emergency and non-emergency calls, so that I can reach the right person quickly.
As an OlderPerson, I want to block unwanted callers or contacts, so that only people I accept can reach me.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive a notification when the older person's vital data is outside a defined normal range, so that I can act quickly.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to view historical vital data in a simple dashboard, so that I can recognize trends over time.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to set individualized thresholds for vital data, so that alerts are appropriate for the specific user.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive a weekly summary of the user's vital data and anomalies, so that I can monitor their health without checking daily.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to share selected vital data with other healthcare professionals, so that care can be coordinated.
As an OlderPerson, I want to receive reminders for medication refills or doctor appointments, so that I do not run out of medication or miss care appointments.
As an OlderPerson, I want to record a short voice note or journal entry, so that I can remember important thoughts or information.
As an OlderPerson, I want to set a timer or alarm using speech, so that I can manage cooking, rest, or appointments.
As an OlderPerson, I want to get the current time, date, and weather forecast from ALFRED, so that I can plan my day.
As an OlderPerson, I want to control smart home door locks or receive reminders to lock doors, so that I can feel safe at home.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to detect unusual inactivity at home and alert a caregiver, so that I can get help even if I cannot call.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to share my location with a trusted contact only during an emergency or when I explicitly request it, so that I keep control over my location privacy.
As an InformalCaregiver, I want to receive alerts when the older person misses a medication dose or exercise session, so that I can follow up.
As an InformalCaregiver, I want to view a summary of the older person's daily activity and well-being, so that I can support them from a distance.
As a SocialCaregiver, I want to schedule recurring reminders and activities for the older person remotely, so that I can manage their daily care plan.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to guide me through a bedtime routine such as dimming lights and taking evening medication, so that I can maintain a regular rhythm.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to suggest nearby restrooms or benches during outdoor walks, so that I can plan comfortable routes.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide navigation guidance using vibration, visual maps, and simple landmarks, so that I can find my way despite mild cognitive impairments.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide real-time bus or train delays and schedule changes, so that I can adapt my public transport plans.
As an OlderPerson, I want to order an accessible taxi or transport service through ALFRED, so that I can travel when public transport is not suitable.
As an OlderPerson, I want to create a shared shopping list that a caregiver or family member can see, so that they can help me with grocery shopping.
As an OlderPerson, I want to set a budget or receive confirmation before ALFRED makes a payment, so that I can avoid spending too much by accident.
As a developer, I want to see user demographics and app usage analytics for my apps, so that I can improve and target my offers.
As a developer, I want to respond to customer feedback within the marketplace, so that I can support my users and improve my app reputation.
As a developer, I want to publish app updates and release notes, so that users can get improvements and understand changes.
As a developer, I want to test my app in a sandbox environment before publishing it to the ALFREDO platform, so that I can find issues safely.
As a developer, I want to use ALFRED API components that include built-in accessibility features such as speech and large buttons, so that my app is suitable for older users.
As a serious games developer, I want to access calibrated sensor data for gameplay while respecting user privacy, so that I can create engaging and safe serious games.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to revoke a specific data-sharing permission without changing my other settings, so that I can stay in control of my data.
details.reason: The existing privacy settings are broad but do not mention per-permission revocation.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to export a readable copy of the personal data ALFRED stores about me, so that I can review or share it with someone I trust.
details.reason: Privacy management usually requires data portability, which is not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to delete specific personal data collected by ALFRED, so that I can remove information I no longer want stored.
details.reason: The backlog gives users control over sharing but not deletion of stored data.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to see a simple log of who accessed my personal data and when, so that I can detect unexpected access.
details.reason: Trust and control over personal data require transparency about access.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to show or play a clear indicator when its microphone is actively listening, so that I always know when I am being recorded.
details.reason: The device only listens on request, but users also need a visible or audible recording indicator.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to train ALFRED to recognize my voice despite changes such as a cold or background noise, so that it keeps reacting only to me.
details.reason: Voice interaction is central, but reliability under changed voice conditions is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to switch ALFRED's spoken language, so that I can use it in my preferred language.
details.reason: Speech interaction for diverse users implies language selection is needed.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to adjust the speech rate of ALFRED at any time with a simple command, so that I can make it faster or slower as needed.
details.reason: A fixed slow speech setting may not fit every moment or user preference.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to confirm critical actions such as sending an emergency alert or making a payment before executing them, so that I do not trigger them by accident.
details.reason: Control over critical activities is emphasized but confirmation before execution is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to cancel an unintended command with a stop word or button, so that I can quickly prevent unwanted actions.
details.reason: Speech interaction needs an undo or cancel mechanism for error prevention.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide help prompts or a list of available voice commands, so that I can learn what I can say.
details.reason: A speech-first device needs discoverability of commands beyond the introduction conversation.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to clarify commands it did not understand, so that I can correct it instead of starting over.
details.reason: Misunderstanding handling is necessary for reliable speech interaction.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to configure emergency contacts and their priority order, so that ALFRED contacts the right person first.
details.reason: Emergency features are present but contact configuration and priority are missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to test the emergency alert without actually contacting emergency services, so that I can trust the feature without causing a false alarm.
details.reason: Users need confidence in safety features through a safe trial.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to warn me early when the battery is getting low during daily use, so that I can charge it before it shuts down.
details.reason: Battery reminders exist for leaving the house, but a general in-session warning is missing.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to automatically switch to a power-saving mode when the battery is low, so that it lasts until I can charge it.
details.reason: Whole-day battery use requires smart power management.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to charge ALFRED without removing it from daily use, so that I can keep it with me while it charges.
details.reason: Wearability and whole-day use suggest convenient charging options.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to connect to my hearing aid or cochlear implant, so that I can hear it clearly through my own hearing device.
details.reason: Hearing trouble adaptation would benefit from direct hearing aid integration.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide visual alerts in addition to audio alerts, so that I do not miss important notifications if I have hearing trouble.
details.reason: Adaptation for hearing trouble requires alternative alert modalities.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want high-contrast display themes, so that I can read visual content more easily.
details.reason: Visual accessibility is mentioned but high contrast is a specific missing option.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to read on-screen text aloud, so that I can understand content even with visual trouble.
details.reason: Visual adaptation should include text-to-speech for displayed content.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want a simple way to reset ALFRED to factory settings, so that I can recover from a serious problem without technical help.
details.reason: Preinstalled and senior-friendly support implies an easy recovery path.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to designate a small group of trusted contacts for emergency and non-emergency calls, so that I can reach the right person quickly.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to block unwanted callers or contacts, so that only people I accept can reach me.
